findings.title: Any successful tool call is treated as proof of diff coverage
findings.description: The cap is skipped after any successful tool call, even if the model never used a tool to read the omitted diff. That leaves the design’s stated goal—preventing a clean PASS when code was not reviewed—unmet. Keep the PASS-to-CONCERNS cap unless the design can establish that the omitted content was actually read.

findings.title: Provider model-field assumptions are inconsistent
findings.description: The required interface says `ChatCompletionChunk.model` is present on every streamed chunk, while D8 says to use the last non-empty value and D11 defines behavior when no model is stamped. Specify which absence cases are valid and how the provider handles them; otherwise the contract and fallback behavior are unclear.
